data.name: Nadeem
data.gender_notes: Nadeem is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ن-د-م (n-d-m); nadīm means 'companion, confidant'. Its root is ن-د-م (n-d-m). A common Muslim given name. Nadeem is a Arabic name meaning “Companion; friend; confidant”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Nadeem expresses “Companion; friend; confidant”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ن-د-م (n-d-m); nadīm means 'companion, confidant'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nadeem total 24, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.
